notes: No registry results are supplied. Selected the explicitly named antibiotic-associated diarrhoea outcome (Clostridium difficile or otherwise unexplained diarrhoea): four of 119 versus 22 of 127. The other candidate is broader diarrhoea: nine of 119 versus 29 of 127. The source reports randomized allocation totals of 132 and 137, but outcome counts use 119 and 127; it says analyses were based on allocated treatment and included 246 children. Thus these are the printed available-data outcome denominators, not full randomized intention-to-treat denominators. Full randomized-population event counts and a separate study-end timepoint are NOT_IN_PACKET.
